prs.author: LeonTsai-cl
prs.title: [What] Add a "Create videos from scratch" section to Video Edit by Chat
prs.review_markdown:
The patch adds user-visible strings without updating the non-English generated message catalogs, and the newly selected Text to Video GUIDs are not connected to the CEIP map used by the reused card. These are user-visible and telemetry regressions that should be fixed.

Full review comments:

- [P2] Add localized entries for the new UI strings — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\view\video_edit_by_chat\widgets\video_edit_by_chat_scratch_section.dart:88-88
  In non-English locales, these new `S.of(context)` keys are not present in the generated locale lookup files (`messages_de.dart`, `messages_fr.dart`, etc.); only `messages_en.dart` was updated. As a result, the new scratch section title and button label fall back to English in localized builds, unlike the existing `video_edit_by_chat_edit_from_scratch` string which has per-locale entries.

- [P2] Wire Text to Video GUIDs into CEIP mapping — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\model\ai_lab_tools\my_edit_feature\my_edit_feature_def.dart:13-16
  When the CMS card matches one of these new `textToVideoIds`, tapping the reused `MyEditFeatureCard` will not send the intended CEIP click log because `MyEditFeatureCard` looks up `aiModelLabFeatureMap[config.id]`, and that map currently only contains `AI_Model_Lab_Feature_TTI` and `_I2V`. This makes the new Text to Video entry silently skip CEIP logging for the GUIDs this helper explicitly selects.

prs.author: WayneXYLin-cl
prs.title: Fix ebug:PRP265523-0014 & PRP265523-0015
prs.review_markdown:
The patch introduces an AIPC-visible build path that can synchronously mutate a provider watched by the same widget, which can break the UI during mode toggles. This should be fixed before considering the patch correct.

Review comment:

- [P2] Defer free-trial refresh out of build — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\view\preview_panel_widget\ai_background_blend_button.dart:93-93
  When the blend button is visible and the user switches into AIPC Mode after `isFreeTrialForDisplayProvider` was true, this call synchronously clears that same watched provider via `refreshDisplayFreeTrialAvailability()` because `freeTrialConsumeCredit` becomes false in AIPC. Riverpod disallows modifying a watched provider while the widget is building, so this can throw during the AIPC toggle path that this patch newly makes visible; trigger the refresh from a post-frame callback/listener instead of directly in `build()`.

prs.title: eBug: PRP265513-0064 Basic Text auto-wrap on overflow
prs.review_markdown:
The paste auto-wrap behavior does not apply to the existing menu/context-menu paste path because the new logic only recognizes the transient `isPaste` flag. This leaves a user-visible paste scenario unaffected by the change.

Review comment:

- [P2] Honor paste origin when detecting pasted text — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\controller\edit\string_editing_handler_base.dart:1789-1791
  When text is pasted via `EditMenuController._onClickPaste` (menu/context-menu paste while in caret mode), that caller invokes `editNotifier.insertText(clipboardData.text!)` without setting `strEdtHandler.isPaste`; because this new detection only keys off `isPaste` and ignores `TextInsertionOrigin.paste`, the new paste auto-wrap path is skipped and long clipboard text can still overflow the canvas. Treat the paste origin here or update that caller to mark the insertion as paste before calling `insertText`.

prs.author: PaxtonHsu-cl
prs.title: [What] eBug:
prs.review_markdown:
The patch can leave the newly added Video Edit by Chat free-trial button in a stale state after user actions that change the estimated credit cost. This affects whether sends are presented and routed as free-trial or paid.

Review comment:

- [P2] Refresh free-trial state on all cost input changes — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\view\video_edit_by_chat\video_edit_by_chat_view.dart:253-253
  When the V2V free-trial button is driven from `getFreeTrialCreditCost()`, the cost depends on `_estimateTotalCredits()` (model settings plus billable duration), but this UI only refreshes availability when the uploaded video path changes. If the user selects an inspiration from an empty prompt, trims the source, or changes quality/audio settings so the estimated cost crosses the remaining-credit threshold, `isFreeTrialProvider` can stay stale and either hide an available trial or keep showing/routing the free-trial send when it should not.

prs.author: AndrewLiang-cl
prs.title: eBug: PRP265513-0064 Basic Text auto-wrap on overflow
prs.review_markdown:
The paste auto-wrap feature is bypassed for an existing paste path that does not set the internal Ctrl+V paste flag, so the patch does not consistently implement its intended behavior.

Review comment:

- [P2] Honor paste origin when constraining pasted text — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\controller\edit\string_editing_handler_base.dart:1789-1789
  When text is pasted via the edit context/menu path, `EditNotifier.insertText(clipboardData.text!)` is called without the Ctrl+V key handler that sets `isPaste`, so this new check treats that paste as programmatic text and never calls `constrainPastedTextLayout()`. In that scenario, oversized pasted title text still overflows instead of enabling auto line break; consider driving this from an explicit paste origin or setting the paste flag at all paste entry points.

prs.author: HenryCHLiu-cl
prs.title: [what] PRP265423-0028 - PMO 8.21 - Video edit by chat (Preview): The …
prs.review_markdown:
The shared backdrop helper is reasonable, but the hover preview now switches to the black-backed texture as soon as the texture provider reports ready, which can occur before the first frame is rendered and regresses the intended thumbnail loading behavior.

Review comment:

- [P2] Gate hover texture on a rendered frame — C:/actions-runner/_work/promeo-pc-promeo/promeo-pc-promeo/promeo_trunk/lib/src/view/common_widget/video_hover_preview.dart:131-131
  When `VideoPlayerController` starts, `_player` is assigned before `apply()` completes, so this widget watches the texture providers while the controller is still inside `enableRenderlessMode`/`loadVideoRenderless`. In that window `onTextureUpdate` can set `textureReady` and `textureId` before `refreshFrame()` has painted the first video frame; with the new `RenderlessTextureStack`, `showTexture` then inserts the opaque black backdrop and hides the poster during hover-preview loading instead of showing the thumbnail until a frame is actually available.

prs.author: StevenLKLiu-cl
prs.title: [What] eBug: PRP265527-0004 & PRP265527-0005
prs.review_markdown:
The patch can consume a user's V2V free trial before later validation rejects the request, causing a lost trial without a generated task. This is a functional regression in the new free-trial flow.

Review comment:

- [P2] Defer free-trial claim until after send validation — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\controller\video_edit_by_chat\video_edit_by_chat_view_controller.dart:2642-2642
  When the free-trial button is used with a V2V request that later fails pre-upload validation (for example a reference image rejected by `VideoEditByChatGenerationMixin._runLifecycle`'s image content gate), `claimFreeTrial` has already called the server claim API here, so the user's trial is consumed even though no generation session is created. Consider claiming only after the request is built and the lifecycle's blocking validation has passed, just before preparing the free-trial credit consumption.

prs.author: AngusHung-cl
prs.title: [What] [Adaptor] Revert the debug stubs wrongly committed into three FFI adaptors (ces_geometry_adaptor / ces_gradient_adaptor / motion_graphic_title_adaptor)
prs.review_markdown:
The patch adds imports from packages that are not declared as direct dependencies in the modified plugin packages. This can break package-level pub resolution, analysis, tests, or independent consumption.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Declare native_utility_ffi in ces_geometry_ffi — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\packages\ces_geometry_ffi\lib\ces_geometry_adaptor.dart:10-10
  When `ces_geometry_ffi` is analyzed, tested, or consumed as its own package, this new package import is not resolvable because `lib/packages/ces_geometry_ffi/pubspec.yaml` does not declare `native_utility_ffi`; only the root app does. Add the same path dependency pattern used by `ces_title_ffi` or keep this package from importing it directly.

- [P1] Declare raw_image_provider in ces_gradient_ffi — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\packages\ces_gradient_ffi\lib\ces_gradient_adaptor.dart:10-10
  When `ces_gradient_ffi` is run as a package, this import cannot be resolved because its pubspec still has `raw_image_provider` commented out. The root app may have it transitively, but package-level `flutter pub get`/analyze/test will fail until this package declares the path dependency directly.

- [P1] Declare native_utility_ffi in motion_graphic_title_ffi — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\packages\motion_graphic_title_ffi\lib\motion_graphic_title_adaptor.dart:8-8
  When `motion_graphic_title_ffi` is analyzed, tested, or consumed independently, this new import is not available because its pubspec does not list `native_utility_ffi`. Add a direct path dependency as with the other FFI package that already calls `ensureFontRegistered`, otherwise package-level builds fail.

prs.author: AndrewLiang-cl
prs.title: eBug: PRP265513-0064 Basic Text auto-wrap on overflow
prs.review_markdown:
The new free-trial and cancellation flows can respectively consume a trial without a generation and apply stale extraction results after cancellation.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Defer the free-trial claim until generation can start — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\controller\video_edit_by_chat\video_edit_by_chat_view_controller.dart:2642-2642

If any of those steps fails, the flow only shows a failed bubble but the limited trial has already been permanently consumed without creating a task; claim it after those pre-generation steps succeed.

- [P2] Recheck cancellation before applying decomposition output — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\controller\magic_designer\ai_design_studio\ai_design_studio_controller.dart:2309-2309
  If the user leaves after `_doImageDecomposition` returns but while the subsequent JSON read or layout work is in progress, this flow has no further version/cancellation check before `_applyAiTextLiftResultAtomically` mutates the project. `cancelExtraction` has already released the busy state and navigation guard, so this stale continuation can still alter the project after the user has left; add checks after the result/read awaits and immediately before applying (and do the same in the deferred edit-view path).

prs.review_markdown:

prs.author: WayneXYLin-cl
prs.title: Fix issue: Showing wrong caption bar clicking back/home button from image designer.
prs.review_markdown:
Home navigation can now leave previously entered feature controllers active when more than one feature was entered.

Review comment:

- [P1] Tear down every entered feature controller — C:\actions-runner\_work\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo-pc-promeo\promeo_trunk\lib\src\controller\main_page_navigtion_option_controller.dart:109-111
  When a notification opens (for example) AI Try-On while Photo Editor is still entered, both controllers can have `hasEnter == true` because each feature's `startPage` enters itself without necessarily leaving the previous feature. The prior Home-navigation path explicitly called `leaveView()` for every entered Photo Editor/Try-On/Product-on-Model controller, but this resolver returns only the current controller (or the first fallback), so the other feature retains its `hasEnter`, page controller, and edit state after navigating Home. Keep the current controller preference if needed, but also clean up all other entered controllers.
